qualification.details: Mental Health Professional: Psychiatrist possessing post graduate degree or diploma / A professional registered with the concerned State Authority under Section 55 (Clinical Psychologist / Mental Health Nurse / Psychiatric Social Worker) of MHCA / a professional having post graduate degree in Ayurveda in Mano Vigyan Avum Manas Roga / Post Graduate degree in Homoeopathy in Psychiatry / Post Graduate degree in Homoeopathy in Unani in Moalijat (Nafasiyatt) / Post Graduate degree in Siddha in Sirappu Muruthuvam with 15 yrs experience in the Mental Health field. Psychiatric Social Worker: Possessing post graduate degree in Social Work or Master of Philosophy in Psychiatric Social Work with 15 yrs experience in the Mental Health field. Mental Health Nurse: Possessing diploma or degree in general nursing / psychiatric nursing with 15 yrs experience in the Mental Health field. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APSMHA Non-official Member posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Non-official Member posts in the Arunachal Pradesh State Mental Health Authority is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Non-official Member posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for the Non-official Member positions by the Arunachal Pradesh State Mental Health Authority.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the APSMHA Non-official Member recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Mental Health Professional post?
faq.answer: The eligibility for Mental Health Professional includes being a Psychiatrist with a PG degree/diploma and 15 years of experience, or other specified professionals with equivalent experience in the mental health field.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for APSMHA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a designated board appointed by the competent authority, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Non-official Member position?
faq.answer: The Non-official Member positions are offered on a contractual basis by the Arunachal Pradesh State Mental Health Authority.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" description.

faq.question: Q9. What is the qualification required for the 'Persons who have or have had mental illness' category?
faq.answer: The qualification for this category is simply that the individual must have had or currently have mental illness.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for the 'Persons representing care givers' post?
faq.answer: Individuals who represent care givers of persons with mental illness or organizations that represent such care givers are eligible to apply for this post.
